Welcome to the '''Let's RP Wiki''' help pages! Whether you've never edited a wiki before or just want to look something up, start here.
{{Card | title = I want to edit an article | text = Anyone with an account can edit. Our [[Help:Getting started|getting started]] guide covers the basics, the [[Help:Cheat sheet|cheat sheet]] lists the formatting codes, and your own [[Special:MyPage/Sandbox|sandbox]] is a safe place to practise. Don't be afraid to edit a page that needs fixing or more detail: a short article is better than none. | link = Help:Getting started | button = Getting started guide | colour = green }} {{Card | title = I want to create a page or upload a picture | text = First search to check the page doesn't exist already: improving an article beats starting a second one. If it doesn't, use the boxes below to start one with the right infobox in place. Not sure what to write? [[Special:WantedPages|Wanted pages]] lists pages that are linked to but not written yet. To add a picture, use [[Special:Upload|Upload file]] and pick a licence. | link = Help:Editing | button = How to edit | colour = orange }} {{Card | title = How can I help? | text = Read through the big directories, like [[:Category:Characters|characters]], [[:Category:Gangs|gangs]] or [[:Category:Businesses|businesses]]. Is the page easy to follow? Does it have pictures and links to related pages? Characters always need updating as their stories go on. For bigger jobs, see the [[Project:Tasks|task list]]. | link = Project:Tasks | button = Tasks and issues }}
== Start a new page ==
Type the page's name (the character's full name, the organization's or the event's) and the page opens with its infobox and headings ready to fill in. type=create preload=Template:Infobox character/preload placeholder=Character name buttonlabel=Create character page break=no width=30 type=create preload=Template:Infobox organization/preload placeholder=Organization name buttonlabel=Create organization page break=no width=30 type=create preload=Template:Infobox event/preload placeholder=Event name buttonlabel=Create event page break=no width=30
== Editing the wiki == You only need to [[Special:CreateAccount|create an account]] to start. There are two ways to edit: '''VisualEditor''', which works like a word processor, and '''source mode''', where you edit the page's wikitext directly. You can switch between them while editing.
{{Card | title = Your first edit | text = A beginner's guide to VisualEditor: edit a page without learning any code. | link = Help:Your first edit }} {{Card | title = VisualEditor basics | text = More tips: adding links, pictures, bold and italic text, and infoboxes. | link = Help:VisualEditor }} {{Card | title = Introduction to source mode | text = Editing the wikitext directly, for when you want full control. | link = Help:Source mode }} {{Card | title = Cheat sheet | text = The codes for links, headings, bold, lists, pictures and templates, on one page. | link = Help:Cheat sheet }}
== The wiki's building blocks ==
{{Card | title = Infoboxes | text = The box at the top of every character, organization and event page: how to fill in each field, and what the badges mean. | link = Help:Infoboxes | colour = purple }} {{Card | title = Templates | text = Every template on the wiki, what it's for and how to add it. | link = Help:Templates | button = See all templates | colour = purple }} {{Card | title = Pictures and licences | text = Uploading screenshots and artwork, and which licence to pick for each. | link = Help:Images | colour = purple }}
== Other resources == {| class="wikitable" ! Editing articles !! Guidelines and resources |- style="vertical-align: top;" | * [[Help:Getting started|Getting started]] * [[Help:Editing|Editing guide]] * [[Help:Cheat sheet|Formatting cheat sheet]] * [[Project:Style guide|Style guide]] * [[Help:Images|Adding pictures to pages]] * [[Help:Tables|Tables]] * [[Help:Standard terms|Standard terms]] | * [[Help:Templates|Templates]] * [[Help:Infoboxes|Infoboxes]] * [[Template:License/doc|Choosing a licence]] * [[Project:Policies|Content policies]] * [[Help:Discussion|Discussion rules]] * [[:Category:Example articles|Example articles]] * When in doubt: [[wikipedia:Wikipedia:Manual of Style|Wikipedia's Manual of Style]] |}
